articles.title: No clear winner after tight New Zealand general election
articles.description: Weeks of coalition talks could follow after preliminary results pointed to a highly divided national parliament.

articles.title: Russian strikes wound nine and damage Ukraine's power network ahead of talks
articles.description: The attacks come before Ukrainian and Russian delegations are due to take part in trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi next week.

articles.title: New Zealand election 'too close to call' with conservative coalition on brink of slim majority
articles.description: The New Zealand election count has ended without a definitive result as the two main parties remain almost deadlocked in the popular vote.

articles.title: UK has 'new pair of eyes' in space as new military satellite enters orbit
articles.description: The UK has a "new pair of eyes" in space after it launched a new military satellite into orbit, the Ministry of Defence (MoD) has announced.
